moa.t: Dose-dependent dopaminergic, β1 and α1 agonism

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Dopamine, IV, 5–15 μg/kg/minute, continued until blood pressure has stabilised. · Response to inotropic support will be unsatisfactory if the circulating blood volume is not corrected.
Dopamine, IV, 5–15 mcg/kg/minute as a continuous infusion. · Continue with dopamine as long as it is necessary to maintain the blood pressure.

cautions.t: Give by infusion pump via a large or central vein

adverse_effects.t: Tachycardia, arrhythmias, peripheral ischaemia, extravasation necrosis
